comparator.name: History (Geschiedenis)
comparator.academicYear: Adopted 2026–2027 Dutch Geschiedenis OER, checked 2026-10-08; annual plans subject to change
comparator.sourceNotes: Adopted Dutch OER 2026–2027 annual plans pp. 22–23 establish one general route: first year 60 EC; second year 48 compulsory + two selected 6-EC choices; third year 30 minor/approved elective allowance + mandatory research college 9 + one selected global research seminar 9 + colloquium 3 + thesis 9. Total 180 EC. The first listed period-one/period-two choices are Capitalism and Inequality and Latin America in Modern History; other level-200 courses require prior examination-board permission. Mandatory Onderzoekscollege Cultuur, Religie en Kennis 500-1800 and the first-listed Research Seminar Global and Political History 1500-present are both taken; the alternative Global Economic and Social History seminar is not added. Genuine third-year profiling space remains generic, subject to approval and at least 12 EC at level 300 for an elective package. A university/faculty minor satisfying entry conditions is allowed under article 12.2; course overlap requires replacement approval. The alternatives abroad 30 or placement 12 plus electives 18 use the same allowance, not additional EC. The 0-EC Dutch language test is embedded in academic skills and not credited again. Research-college themes and annual plans may change. The English History and International Studies trajectory and its thesis codes are not substituted for the Dutch target.

routeSelection.basis: The Dutch Geschiedenis target uses its general Algemeen graduation direction, the broadest route, rather than a specialized direction or the distinct English History and International Studies trajectory. Second-year choices use the first listed 6-EC course in each period; the third-year extra research seminar uses the first listed alternative. No selection is based on UCR fit.

exception.reason: The adopted current OER now establishes the complete 180-EC Dutch Geschiedenis/Algemeen pathway and its choices. The previous external-credit and source-access gaps are resolved. Independent UCR assessment and, if feasible, construction of a comparison remain a separate stage; no absence of a UCR match is asserted.
exception.curriculumContext: Verified 60+60+60 EC Dutch general route, with two neutral year-two choices, one of the mutually exclusive additional year-three seminars, 30-EC profiling space and a 9-EC thesis plus 3-EC colloquium. The original 60-EC subset is incorporated into the full reconstruction. Prior unresolved rationale is preserved historically in the remediation register.
